info.title: PayStream Payments API
info.description: RESTful API for processing payments, managing subscriptions, and handling refunds for enterprise merchants.

authentication.description: All API requests must include a valid API key in the Authorization header. Keys are issued per merchant account.
authentication.note: API keys should never be exposed in client-side code or version control systems.

endpoint.description: Initiates a new payment transaction. Supports credit cards, debit cards, and digital wallets.

field.name: amount
field.description: Payment amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Must be a positive integer.

field.name: payment_method_id
field.description: The ID of a previously created payment method object.

field.name: description
field.description: An arbitrary string attached to the payment for your records.

field.name: metadata
field.description: A set of key-value pairs you can attach to a payment for internal tracking.

response.description: Payment created successfully and is processing.
response.field: Unique payment identifier prefixed with pay_.
Current status. One of: pending, succeeded, failed, requires_action.
The amount charged in smallest currency unit.
ISO 8601 timestamp of when the payment was created.

response.description: Bad request. The request body is missing required fields or contains invalid values.
Payment failed. The card was declined or the payment method is invalid.

errors.error: The payment method was declined by the issuing bank.
The card has insufficient funds for this transaction.
The specified currency is not supported by this merchant account.

endpoint.description: Retrieves the details of a previously created payment by its unique identifier.

path-params.param: The unique identifier of the payment to retrieve.

response.field: Whether this payment has been refunded.

response.description: Payment not found. The specified ID does not exist on this account.

endpoint.description: Refunds a payment that has already been captured. Partial refunds are supported.

field.name: payment_id
field.description: The ID of the payment to refund.

field.name: amount
field.description: Amount to refund in smallest currency unit. Omit to issue a full refund.

field.name: reason
field.description: Reason for the refund. One of: duplicate, fraudulent, customer_request.

endpoint.note: Refunds typically take 5-10 business days to appear on the customer's statement.
